overall: The AG found the Committee violated the OML by posting an insufficiently specific notice for its September 9 meeting, omitting the investigation topic it anticipated discussing. It also found unraised violations in notice posting, minutes notice, and complaint response timing, and ordered member training and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the topics listed on the notice for the September 9 meeting were not sufficiently specific; the notice listed only minutes approval.
allegations.key_passage: Because a discussion of this topic was anticipated by Chair Cameron, it should have been included in the notice of the September 9 meeting.

allegations.summary: Investigation found the notice did not show the date and time it was posted, as required by 940 CMR 29.03(1).
allegations.key_passage: The date of posting the notice of the September 9 meeting does not appear on the notice itself and is not readily available online where the notice can be found.

allegations.summary: Investigation found the Committee approved six sets of minutes without the notice identifying them by date, contrary to the notice requirement for minutes review.
allegations.key_passage: when a public body anticipates reviewing and approving meeting minutes during a meeting, it must identify on the meeting notice which minutes it plans to review, if known.

allegations.summary: Investigation found the Committee responded to the complaint a month after receiving it, missing the 14-business-day deadline for review and response.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Committee responded to the complaint one month after it received the complaint and ten days after our office inquired about the status of the response, thereby failing to meet the deadline set out in the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: All current members of the Committee must attend an Open Meeting Law webinar training presented by the Attorney General's office within 90 days of the letter's date.
The Committee must immediately and in the future comply with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
